card.name: Digit 2 inside numbers and tables
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (sometimes 1 or 7) written as a single character inside a decimal number, dose range, section number or table row of numbers. It is typical of label tables and numbered headings.

modes.label: Decimal digit in tables
modes.description: A single digit after a decimal point or inside a row of table figures.
modes.example: Patients with Events Per 1000 Patients Epilepsy Psychiatric Other Total 1.0 5.7 1.0 <<2>>.4 3.4 8

modes.label: Section number
modes.description: The digit starting a numbered subsection such as 2.1 or 2.3 in the dosage section.

modes.label: Dose or percent value
modes.description: A digit starting or ending a dose figure or percentage.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly favors a few unrelated word tokens.
card.plain: It fires on a lone digit, mostly 2, inside numbers in tables, doses and section numbers.
